scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server,inngest --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:inngest"
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd server lint && bun run --cwd client lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd client typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/contracts test && bun run --cwd server test && bun run --cwd client test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd server build && bun run --cwd client build
scripts.check: bun run generate && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
